title: fix(metadata): a skill the platform registers keeps its own slot beside an app's same-named skill
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8VxWpZoGVso4DL2WGJUUUeV)_

Fixes #37013

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — no skills/ page names `_provenance` or its values, and the new value is one no author writes: the artifact door refuses it

## 维护者速读

- 平台自带的技能和应用里同名的技能以后各存一份、互不覆盖：应用装上不会顶掉平台那份，平台启动或撤回时也不会改写或删掉应用那份；重启、集群其他节点读回来也是两份。
- 属于云端问数加载应用技能这条线，是云端那张卡需要的平台这一半。
- 出错的话最多是同名技能里某一份没被读到，不碰业务数据，可直接撤回。
- 本 PR 带了 ADR-0150 D4 和 ADR-0010 §3.5 的修订说明，属受治理改动（Tier H）：由维护者合并，或经维护者批准后合并。

## Governed

This PR touches `docs/adr/**` and is governed (Tier H): it is landed by the maintainer, or after the maintainer's approval.

Surface: `packages/spec/src/**` (one enum value, describes, comments), `content/docs/references/**` (generated), `packages/metadata/src/**`, `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/metadata-client.ts`, `docs/adr/**` (two amendment notes), `.changeset/**`.

## What changes

The metadata store keyed a package-less write under a name one package held as that package's customization (ADR-0150 D4), let a package's first item take over the name's bare slot, and let a removal naming no package take every slot of a one-holder name. A skill the platform's own code registers at boot is package-less, so it and an app's same-named skill overwrote each other in both directions. This gives the platform's record a marked slot of its own. The mark (`_provenance: 'platform'`) is a store-slot marker only.

**Write and removal.**
- `MetadataManager.register(type, name, data, { origin: 'platform' })` stamps the body `_provenance: 'platform'` and fills the name's bare slot whatever packages hold the name, in the registry and in `sys_metadata` (`slottedWriteKey`, shared by `storeWriteKey` and `storeRowWriteKey`).
- A package's first item never takes over a bare slot holding the platform's record. `DatabaseLoader` reads the stamp off the stored row's body, and for a bundled type (`email_template`) off the written member's row. The environment's own item in the bare slot is still taken over, as before.
- A package-less environment write under a platform name keeps today's rule (card item 3 as amended): it takes the bare slot without the stamp, and the platform's next registration restores its record.
- `MetadataManager.unregister(type, name, { origin: 'platform' })` takes only the record the platform registered (`storePlatformRemovalKeys`), for every type, carried to every loader (`MetadataLoaderDeleteOptions.platformOnly`; `DatabaseLoader` and `MemoryLoader` check each stored body) and every cluster peer (`ClusterMetadataRemoval.platformOnly`, dropped when malformed). A package's item of the name and the environment's own item stay, and nothing is refused however many packages hold the name.

**Reads and the readers that rebuild the store.**
- `MetadataManager.getPlatformItem(type, name)` reads the platform's record only: never a package's item, never the environment's own.
- The plural read (`pluralEntryKeys`, behind `loadMany` and `loadManyKeyed`) gives the platform's entry a key of its own beside a one-holder name, so the boot pass is handed both rows.
- `list`'s loader admission (`admitLoaderSlots`): the platform's record shadows, and is shadowed by, the platform's record only.
- A read naming a package is never answered from the platform's record (`readIdentity`): the registry's platform slot defers to the loaders, where the package's item may be stored.
- For `action`, a package-less registry slot the platform's registration stamped is the platform's (`platformSlotsOf`) whether or not a loader stores it, as an unstored one already was (#32560).
- Reads naming no package keep their rules (card item 4).

**Where the stamp can enter (card item 1 as sharpened).** It is set only by `register` with the option. Every other door strips or refuses it:
- `register` without the option strips it. A stored row the boot pass re-registers keeps it only when the `datasource:` row held it as read (`storedPlatformRows`, recorded in `loadMany`), never because its caller set it after the read.
- `registerInMemory` and `save` strip it.
- A body served from any loader other than a `datasource:` one (`file:`, `memory:`) is served without it (`servedLoaderBody`, at every loader read of the manager).
- The artifact door refuses an item that carries it, with or without a manifest id: `VALIDATION_ERROR` / 400 at `_provenance`, naming the fix (`artifactItemPlatformStampRefusal`).
- The protocol's write door already removes `_provenance` before it persists (`DERIVED_PROVENANCE_KEYS`).
- A body that names a package is that package's item, whatever `_provenance` it carries (`isPlatformOrigin`).

Class-level options, as `MetadataUnregisterOptions.packageId` already is: the spec's `MetadataWriteOptions` is not widened.

**Spec.** `MetadataProvenanceSchema` (`packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-protection.zod.ts`) gains `'platform'`, so the stamp is a declared value of the `_provenance` envelope key every schema spreads and survives a parse. Describe strings and comments updated; `content/docs/references/**` regenerated by `gen:docs` (44 reference pages, one enum cell each).

**UI.** `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/metadata-client.ts` types the layered read's `provenance` from the spec's `MetadataProvenance`, so it accepts the new value and cannot trail the enum again.

**Declaration and level.** `_provenance` is on the authorable surface (`authorable-surface.base.json`), and `SkillSchema` now accepts a value it refused, so by AGENTS.md's Post-Task Checklist step 3 the kind is `added`. The kind sets the level: `minor` on the three packages the diff moves (`@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/metadata`, `@object-ui/data-objectstack`). `Clause-②: yes (widening)` stands: nothing an author could write before is refused now (the artifact door's strict parse refused the value before this PR, and the door refuses it now). The authorable key set is unchanged.

The consumer (cloud#4935) passes `{ origin: 'platform' }` from its boot registration and withdrawal.

## Tests

- `packages/metadata/src/package-slotted-store.test.ts` (10 cases): the write, takeover, removal and read rules over the registry store, and copy semantics of stamp/strip; CONTROL: the environment's bare item is still taken over and D4 still folds a package-less write.
- `packages/metadata/src/loaders/database-loader.test.ts`, first #37013 describe (9 cases): one per Acceptance line, registry plus `DatabaseLoader` over the shared mock driver, a primed restart included.
- Same file, second #37013 describe (11 cases), from the stored rows and at every seam: platform, package, then platform again, read by a process primed from the rows (`get` naming the package, `getPlatformItem`, `list`, `loadMany`); a node whose registry holds nothing of the name, with the door's loader ahead of the rows and after them; a read naming the package beside the registry's platform slot; `registerInMemory`; `save`; a row given the stamp by its caller after the read; a `file:` loader's and a `memory:` loader's stamped body; the platform's withdrawal beside the door's package copy; `MemoryLoader.delete` with `platformOnly`; a type outside the by-package set (registry, cold node, an in-memory-only item, the door's copy; CONTROL: the platform's own record is withdrawn).
- Same file: `action` (the platform's stored record named as the platform in a refusal beside two packages); `email_template` (the environment's `fr-FR`, then the platform's `en-US`, then a package's first `en-US`: the platform's row stays and a cold read finds it).
- `packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager-cluster.test.ts` (2 cases): a peer drops the platform's record and keeps the package's, in its registry (an in-memory-only item included) and its door; a removal whose platform scope is not `true` is dropped.
- `packages/metadata/src/plugin-artifact-platform-stamp.test.ts` (3 cases): the artifact door refuses the value with and without a manifest id, before storing anything; CONTROL: no provenance or the package's is stored.
- `packages/spec/src/ai/skill.test.ts`: a stored skill carrying `_provenance: 'platform'` parses; CONTROL: a value outside the enum is refused at `_provenance`.

<details><summary>Ablations (each mutation landed on disk, the #37013 cases run, restored to HEAD)</summary>

Cases red per ablation, over the #37013 cases of the four metadata test files above:

| Ablated | Red |
|:--|:--|
| strip in `register` off | 3 |
| boot exception read by loader, not by the row's stamp | 1 |
| `registerInMemory` strip off | 1 |
| `save` strip off | 1 |
| `servedLoaderBody` returns the body as stored | 2 |
| artifact door refusal off | 2 |
| `readIdentity` answers a package read from the platform slot | 1 |
| `admitLoaderSlots`: a loader's platform row shadowed by a package slot | 1 |
| `admitLoaderSlots`: a platform slot shadows a loader's package item | 1 |
| `pluralEntryKeys` folds the platform entry into the holder's | 1 |
| `platformSlotsOf` ignores the stamp | 1 |
| bundled row predicate reads the slot's first row | 1 |
| non-slotted removal keys unfiltered | 1 |
| `DatabaseLoader.delete` non-slotted row check off | 1 |
| `MemoryLoader.delete` non-slotted check off | 1 |
| `MemoryLoader.delete` slotted `platformOnly` branch off | 3 |
| peer registry branch off | 1 |
| `receivedRemovalOf` `platformOnly` line off | 2 |
| `DatabaseLoader.delete` slotted row check always true | 1 |

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- A read naming a package that holds no slot no longer falls back to the platform's record: the platform's record is never a package's item. It still falls back to the environment's own item (D3), unchanged.
- The realtime `deleted` event of a platform withdrawal names the type and name with no package, as a removal by name does; only the cluster payload carries `platformOnly`.
- ADR-0150 D4 and ADR-0010 §3.5 carry dated amendment notes for this change (ADR-0150's cites cloud ADR-0118, merged as `e738843b`), so the recorded rules and the code agree (Prime Directive 13).

## Verification

Read first:
1. `packages/metadata/src/package-slotted-store.ts`: `slottedWriteKey` (the two platform branches), the platform helpers above `isPackageCaller`, `readIdentity`, `pluralEntryKeys`, `platformSlotsOf`.
2. `packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager.ts`: the stamp/strip in `register`, `storedPlatformRows` and `servedLoaderBody`, `registerInMemory`, `save`, `admitLoaderSlots`, the platform branch in `unregisterAt`, `getPlatformItem`, the peer branch.
3. `packages/metadata/src/loaders/database-loader.ts`: the row predicate in `slottedSaveTarget` and the `platformOnly` deletes; `memory-loader.ts` delete.
4. `packages/metadata/src/plugin.ts`: `artifactItemPlatformStampRefusal`.
5. `packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-protection.zod.ts`: the one enum value.
6. `docs/adr/0150-…md` (end of D4) and `docs/adr/0010-metadata-protection-model.md` (§3.5): the two amendment notes.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata exec vitest run src/loaders/database-loader.test.ts -t 37013` → 23 passed.

## Local runs (head `b934aafc`, `main` merged at `8e4ac50d4`)

- `@objectstack/metadata`: `vitest run` 83 files, 2675 passed before the last test commits; the #37013 cases after them: `database-loader.test.ts -t 37013` 23 passed, cluster 2, door 3. `tsc --noEmit` exit 0.
- `ui/packages/data-objectstack`: `tsc --noEmit` reports no error in `metadata-client.ts` (the line CI failed on at `8b2d8510`); the package's other errors locally are unbuilt sibling `dist/` and are CI's to judge.
- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates --commands`, 124 commands): every one exit 0 after three real reds fixed (`check:docs` and `check:generated`, the reference page regenerated; `check:test-source-alias`, the door test loads `metadata-fs` at collection). The spec `.d.ts`-reading gates were re-run after `check:generated --fix` built the dist: exit 0. NOT MEASURED locally, exit 3, left to CI: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (shallow clone).
- Head `c018389c` adds the two ADR notes only: `check-adr-links`, `check:adr-anchors`, `check:adr-symbol-anchors`, `check:adr-index`, `check:pm-governed-merges`, `check-issue-citations`, `check:doc-anchors`, `check:closed-ceremony-text`, `check:role-word`, `check:nul-bytes` exit 0.
